# Tables and fences

A paragraph with no tag runs on into the table under it,
| Rule | Note |
|---|---|
| a write never blocks | `[ev: corpus B1]` |
| the station always restarts | `[ev: devguide x.txt:1]` |

| Rule | Note |
|---|---|
| a ticket never sleeps | `[ev: corpus B2]` |
| a check always runs | `[ev: retro r1 Δ1]` |

- A bullet runs into the fence under it:
```java
// never null here
x.always();
```

```java
// silently ignored
```
[ev: code toolbelt/x.sh:3]

- A bullet before a fence that a blank line splits off.

```
throws on a bad slot
```
